plans.note: Separate caps for each party in 9.1 and 9.2; check IBM's cap amount/formula, whether consequential-damages exclusion is mutual, and whether carve-outs (IP indemnity, confidentiality, death/personal injury, gross negligence) survive. Section 5.4 may add further disclaimers that effectively erode the cap.

8.1 is IBM's indemnity — test IP infringement scope, defense/settlement obligations and any exclusions. 8.2 is our indemnity — confirm it stays narrow (our content/AUP breach) and is not open-ended. sec-1 appears to be the indemnification procedure (notice/cooperation) applying to both.

No non-compete heading; 14.16 Freedom of Action likely runs in IBM's favour (IBM free to serve competitors), which does not restrict us. Confirm 14.11 No Resale and the AUP do not operate as a restriction on our business lines.
Check 14.16 and the Services/Charges sections for any requirement to source hosting solely from IBM; expect none in this hosting agreement.
No pricing-parity language expected; scan Charges for any obligation on us to extend best terms to IBM. MFN in our favour would be acceptable and not flagged.
14.8 Personnel is the likely home of any hiring restriction; check whether it binds us, its duration, whether it is mutual, and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.

3.4 governs convenience termination — check notice period, whether the right is mutual or IBM-only, and any termination charges/unamortized-cost recovery. Cross-check 3.5 for exit payments and 3.3 for cure periods.
3.2 Renewal — confirm whether renewal is automatic, the non-renewal notice window length, who must give it, and whether renewal pricing is capped or set at then-current rates.

14.3 Choice of Law is the operative clause (likely New York); confirm venue/courts rather than foreign arbitration. 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 Actions Period (limitations shortening) are related but noted separately in rationale, not double-flagged.

14.10 — check whether we may assign to affiliates/successors without consent, whether change of control is a deemed assignment or gives IBM a termination right, and whether IBM may freely assign or subcontract.

12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses define IP allocation; 11.6 Content and 14.18 Data Protection should confirm we retain ownership of our content and data. Check 14.6 for any trademark licence we grant to IBM.
12.1 is the grant — test scope for affiliate and contractor use, revocability, term, and whether 14.17 narrows it further; 14.11 No Resale may limit permitted users.

11.3 Suspected Violations is the likely inspection/investigation right against us; check notice, frequency, scope, cost allocation and any suspension power. 13.2 AUP and 11.5 Capacity Planning may add monitoring rights.

No liquidated damages heading; check 4.2 for late-payment interest and 3.5 for early-termination charges that function as penalties on us. Any service credits running to us are beneficial and should not be flagged.

5.1 is IBM's warranty — assess substance (workmanlike/service-level), duration and remedy. 5.2 Exclusivity of Warranties and 5.4 Other Disclaimers likely disclaim implied warranties; 11.2 contains our reciprocal reps and 12.2 maintenance obligations.
No insurance heading in the outline; check 5.3 Security, 14.12 Risk of Loss and 14.18 Data Protection for any coverage undertaking before concluding the rule is missing.

Volume or minimum commitments would sit in 4.1 Charges (or in Order Forms/Service Option Attachments referenced there); 11.5 Capacity Planning may impose committed capacity. Flag only if a take-or-pay exists without an exit.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the likely location for data return and wind-down assistance; check for a defined transition period, data-return format and deletion obligations, and whether 14.2 Survival preserves them.
